The statement that "both plant and animal cells share... a cell wall" is false; cell walls are a defining feature of plant cells, but animal cells do not have cell walls (they have an extracellular matrix instead). Consequently, the selected answer (C) is incorrect because it includes the cell wall, whereas the correct answer should be B (cell membrane, nucleus, mitochondrion), as mitochondria are present in almost all eukaryotic cells, while chloroplasts and cell walls are exclusive to plants.
